ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, shading represents land and blank space represents ocean; a latitude line marked 40° crosses this ideal region. Jia is located near the 40° latitude line and at a coastal position on the west coast of the continent; Yi is located near the east coast of the continent. Then reason: The setting that the obliquity of the ecliptic becomes 0° means that the direct point of the Sun no longer moves north and south, and the seasonal movement of pressure belts and wind belts basically does not exist. Therefore, if the climate type of place Jia still exists on Earth, it should not be a climate formed by relying on the seasonal movement of pressure belts and wind belts, but is more likely to be a temperate oceanic climate formed on the west coast of a mid-latitude continent under the perennial influence of westerlies and the ocean. A temperate oceanic climate is mild and humid throughout the year, suitable for the growth of lush pasture, and the typical agricultural regional type is mostly animal husbandry, especially dairy farming.
